sections.title: V18 Updates — New Action Buttons & Configurable Delays
features: Share Intent Only Button — sends share intent to FB Lite without tapping POST, giving full control over when to post
Switch to Next Account Button — instantly switches to the next account in the list without restarting the full cycle, per-device index tracking built in
Go to Home Screen Button — closes FB Lite cleanly by sending KEYCODE_HOME instead of force-stop, preserving app state
Launch FB Lite (URL) Button — launches FB Lite using the specific URL intent (am start with VIEW action and https://fb.me) for reliable app opening
Topbar Close FB Lite now sends home screen (KEYCODE_HOME) instead of force-stop — faster and safer
Topbar Launch FB Lite now uses the URL-based intent for consistent launch behavior
Swipe Overhaul — swipe delay reduced from 6s to 1s, swipe now covers full screen (y: 950 → 100) in just 400ms, retries reduced from 3 to 2 for faster account switching
Opening FB Lite now uses the URL intent (am start ... VIEW https://fb.me) with a configurable wait time instead of force-stopping the app
Confirm Logout Delay — new 6-second configurable pause before the confirm-logout tap ensures the dialog is fully visible
Two new configurable timing values (FB Launch Wait and Confirm Logout Delay) added to the Additional Timing UI in FB Automation settings and to admin_panel.html
Admin Panel Persistence — all form fields now save to localStorage and survive page refresh; each tab has a Reset to Defaults button
